# EvalScope performance client

Unmodified official PyPI source distribution, version 1.13.0, Apache-2.0.

- Source: https://pypi.org/project/evalscope/1.13.0/
- Upstream: https://github.com/modelscope/evalscope
- Archive SHA-256: e0a57e9a0b4ed5716e5c7a7cad4747d5cf1831de2a9e129d9b4894a8fb0d217d

HCU Bench installs `evalscope[perf]` from this archive into a separate cached
virtual environment. Third-party Python dependencies are not vendored and
require a package index or a preconfigured wheelhouse on the first run.
The serving Python environment is not modified. No upstream source patches.
